trust_decision.summary: Whether prompt text is trusted enough to be compiled and run as an EEx template (Elixir source). At the pinned commit every string prompt form is passed to EEx.eval_string, including content returned at runtime by a `prompt: fn input, ctx -> ... end` function, which is often built from action arguments. The fix evaluates only statically configured prompts.

landing_point.why: The summary names EEx evaluation of prompt content. The first EEx.eval_string call in the only prompt module is the string-template clause of normalize_to_context.

fix_sites.entry_point: Ash.run_action on a generic action using `run prompt(model, prompt: fn ...)` (AshAi.Actions.prompt/2 macro -> AshAi.Actions.Prompt.run/3); function returns a binary
same; function returns a {system, user} tuple (system part)
same; function returns a {system, user} tuple (user part)
same; function returns a list with %ReqLLM.Message{content: binary}
same; function returns a list of string-keyed maps %{"content" => binary}
same; function returns a list of atom-keyed maps %{content: binary}

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lib/ash_ai/actions/prompt.ex:131-134 (public AshAi.Actions.Prompt.run/3, also reachable as a {AshAi.Actions.Prompt, opts} tuple). A non-function :prompt in opts built at runtime still reaches EEx.eval_string at fix.diff:108-109 and 188-189. This is unchanged by the fix, which trusts every non-function prompt as static.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The docs present non-function prompts as statically configured DSL templates (lib/ash_ai/actions.ex:31-35), so a solver can argue that a caller passing runtime text as the prompt to run/3 is misusing the API. Only the function form is plausibly user-built.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Statically configured string, tuple and message-list prompts, plus the default @prompt_template, must still be evaluated as EEx with @input/@context assigns (documented and tested). Removing EEx everywhere breaks them.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: transform_flow callback output (FlowState.messages) re-templated through the same EEx helper before generation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding 'templating after flow customisation' could reuse process_message_templates on flow_state.messages. Those messages are produced at runtime by a callback, the same trust class as the prompt function.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: model spec resolved from a function, or a system_prompt option, run through EEx for interpolation
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Plausible convenience: 'model/system prompt may use <%= @input %>'. It would sit in the same module but a different option.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second EEx call in the tool loop (for example templating tool-result or system messages between iterations)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The tool loop rebuilds message lists from tool output (LLM- and user-influenced) in a separate file. It would be a real second implementation at distance from the prompt normalizer.

O9_family: CWE-94 code injection (server-side template evaluation of runtime text)
